newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Congress panel to probe organized crime.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Congress panel to probe organized crime.

text.p: Members of Argentina's Congress announced on Thursday they will create a special committee to probe allegations of organised crime that have tainted the Peronist government.

The idea for the committee was born last year but given urgency by former Economy Minister Domingo Cavallo's campaign against graft and accusations that the government is aiding a businessman who he alleges heads a crime syndicate.

"We have agreed on the creation of a committee that will be responsible for analysing, studying and proposing elements tied to possible crimes," Jorge Matzkin, head of the ruling Peronist bloc in the lower house of Congress, told reporters.
The Peronists and their congressional opponents must still agree on operating details but the panel could be functioning in several weeks, a Matzkin aide said in an interview.
Its creation follows a scandal that erupted last September over a smuggling ring involving customs officials responsible for contraband of $10 billion over four years.
But legislators say the thrust of their initial probes will be into the activities of postal tycoon Alfredo Yabran.
Cavallo alleges he is building a monopoly in the deregulated postal business for criminal ends and has suggested Yabran's security interests have been involved in illegal activities.

"Afterward, the Chamber of Deputies will be able to say to society that it can rest easy because this is just another economic group or a mafia that justice must investigate fully," Carlos Alvarez, leader of the centre-left Frepaso movement, said on Monday.
Cavallo, who was fired by President Carlos Menem in July and who is running in legislative elections in October, denounced Yabran in a detailed address to Congress in August.

"Unfortunately I believe President Menem and other senior officials are afraid of Yabran," Cavallo said this week. "I am convinced that if Yabran, who heads a mafia, gets away with it with the clear support of the government, that means it is clear that what is happening is a clear strategy planned jointly by the government and Yabran."
